title: Portugal captures Malacca
summary: On 15 August 1511, Afonso de Albuquerque's forces took Malacca from Sultan Mahmud Shah, who fled. The city commanded the strait through which sea trade between China and India passed.
why: Gave Europeans a grip on Asia's spice and sea trade.

notes.problem: 'Ending the Malacca Sultanate' overstates: source says Mahmud Shah retreated and his son founded the Sultanate of Johor.
